@legend.kids.arith core.legend
    namespace=kids.arith
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    imports=kids.common
    doc="Counting things people have, events that change the counts, totals, comparisons and bare arithmetic"

@kids.arith.holding core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Someone has a number of items of one kind. A statement sets the count; later events change it."
    example="Tom has 5 apples."
    negative="Tom likes apples."

@kids.arith.holding.owner core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who has them?"

@kids.arith.holding.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.holding.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many are there?"
    observe=true
    compute=true

@kids.arith.holding.start core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many were there at the start?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.change core.type
    extends=core.event
    doc="Something happens to the number of items someone has. Events are applied in dialog order (core.seq)."
    example="Ana gives Tom 3 apples."

@kids.arith.change.who core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is it about (who gives, gets, eats, loses, buys or breaks)?"

@kids.arith.change.to core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who receives the items?"

@kids.arith.change.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.change.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many items are involved?"

@kids.arith.give core.type
    extends=kids.arith.change
    doc="One person gives some items to another person: who gives, to receives."
    example="Ana gives Tom 3 apples."

@kids.arith.receive core.type
    extends=kids.arith.change
    doc="Someone gets, receives or finds some items."
    example="Tom finds 2 marbles."

@kids.arith.eat core.type
    extends=kids.arith.change
    doc="Someone eats some items."
    example="Tom ate 2 apples."

@kids.arith.lose core.type
    extends=kids.arith.change
    doc="Someone loses some items."
    example="Mia lost 3 marbles."

@kids.arith.buy core.type
    extends=kids.arith.change
    doc="Someone buys some items (only the counts are tracked here, not the money)."
    example="Ben buys 4 pencils."

@kids.arith.break core.type
    extends=kids.arith.change
    doc="Someone breaks some items."
    example="Sam broke 2 pencils."

@kids.arith.total core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="How many items of one kind there are altogether, over everybody or over two named people."
    example="How many apples are there altogether?"

@kids.arith.total.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.total.who1 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the first person to count?"

@kids.arith.total.who2 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the second person to count?"

@kids.arith.total.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many are there altogether?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.leader core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Who has the most items of one kind, or who of two named people has more."
    example="Who has more apples, Tom or Ana?"

@kids.arith.leader.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.leader.who1 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the first person to compare?"

@kids.arith.leader.who2 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the second person to compare?"

@kids.arith.leader.winner core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who has more?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.gap core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="How many more (or fewer) items of one kind the first person has than the second."
    example="How many more apples does Tom have than Ana?"

@kids.arith.gap.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.gap.who1 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the first person?"

@kids.arith.gap.who2 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the second person?"

@kids.arith.gap.diff core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is the difference between the two counts?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.verdict core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Yes or no: does the first person have more items than the second?"
    example="Does Tom have more apples than Ana?"

@kids.arith.verdict.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.verdict.who1 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the first person?"

@kids.arith.verdict.who2 core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who is the second person?"

@kids.arith.verdict.answer core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Is it yes or no?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.has core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Yes or no: does someone have any items of one kind?"
    example="Does Tom have any apples?"

@kids.arith.has.owner core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who might have them?"

@kids.arith.has.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.has.answer core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Is it yes or no?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.calc core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A bare calculation of two numbers: plus, minus, times, divided_by."
    example="What is 7 plus 5?"

@kids.arith.calc.op core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which operation (plus, minus, times, divided_by)?"

@kids.arith.calc.a core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is the first number?"

@kids.arith.calc.b core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is the second number?"

@kids.arith.calc.result core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is the result?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.half core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Half of a number."
    example="What is half of 10?"

@kids.arith.half.n core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="Which number?"

@kids.arith.half.result core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is half of it?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.double core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Double a number."
    example="What is double 6?"

@kids.arith.double.n core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="Which number?"

@kids.arith.double.result core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is double it?"
    compute=true

@kids.arith.calc.op2 core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which second operation (plus, minus, times, divided_by)?"

@kids.arith.calc.c core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="What is the third number?"

@kids.arith.relation core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="One person has some more, some fewer, or some times as many items of one kind as another: a comparison told as a statement. It fixes the count of whichever of the two is not known yet, from the one that is."
    example="Ana has 3 more apples than Ion."
    negative="Ana has more apples."

@kids.arith.relation.who core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who has more, fewer or times as many?"

@kids.arith.relation.ref core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Compared with whom?"

@kids.arith.relation.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.relation.kind core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="More, fewer or times as many?"

@kids.arith.relation.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many more, fewer or times as many?"

@kids.arith.negated core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Someone did not do something to the counts (did not give, eat, lose, buy, break or get any). It is understood and said back, and nothing changes: the counts are not touched."
    example="Ana does not give Ion any apples."
    negative="Ana gives Ion 3 apples."

@kids.arith.negated.who core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who did not do it?"

@kids.arith.negated.to core.key
    value=$core.agent
    card=one
    ask="Who would have received the items?"

@kids.arith.negated.verb core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What did not happen (give, eat, lose, buy, break, get)?"

@kids.arith.negated.item core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@kids.arith.negated.count core.key
    value=number
    card=one
    ask="How many (when a number was said)?"
